architecture.mechanism: Adaptive dynamic voltage support (DVS) control strategy for LCC-HVDC system
architecture.intervention: Implement adaptive DVS capability in the solar farm inverter system that can adjust to segmented fault ride-through behavior without requiring knowledge of grid parameters
architecture.expected_effect: Enhanced voltage stability during voltage sags, reducing tripping frequency to at most 2 exceptions per year
architecture.falsification_test: Simulate the 0.6-per-unit, 200-millisecond voltage sag events on the inverter system with and without the adaptive DVS control, measuring the number of trips over a 365-day period
